# teams_network_roaming_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing NetworkRoamingPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `allow_ip_video` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowIPVideo parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `media_bit_rate_kb` (Number) Maps to the -MediaBitRateKb parameter.
